description:
## Problem
- `docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md:145-157` claims DuckDB sorting verifies end to end, which is false.
- No user-facing doc says which platforms can reach `applied_verified`, render layout at execution, or ship templates.
- ADR-001 and ADR-003 need addenda for the landed changes.

## Change
- Fix the receipts doc and document the new verdict and constraint kinds.
- Generate `docs/reference/tuning-platform-support.md` from the registry and introspector map: per platform, template available, renders at execution per type, introspector or facts reader, and whether it can reach `applied_verified`.
- Add ADR addenda.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- The matrix is generated and tested for freshness, not hand-written.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
